q: How do I work out emissions from trucking Ballari iron ore to the port?
title: Ballari ore trucks to port: emissions
short: Multiply tonnes carried by road kilometres and by a factor for the truck class, or use the diesel the transporter actually burnt times 2.68 kg CO2 per litre. If you pay the transporter, it is your Scope 3 category 4.
audience: Iron ore sellers and traders in the Ballari Hospet belt moving ore by road to ports or rail sidings

ul: Distance based: tonnes x km x factor per tonne km. The Smart Freight Centre India default for 30 to 50 tonne trucks is 0.0663 kg CO2e per tonne km.
Fuel based: litres of diesel from the transporter x 2.68 kg CO2 per litre. Better when you can get it.

p: Ore trucks often return empty. Published tonne km factors usually include typical empty running; do not add the empty leg again.
Moving ore to a rail siding and then by rail cuts emissions per tonne km sharply. Calculate each leg with its own mode factor.
